summary: In-app APK update + Direct install link flow validated end-to-end for Partner app. Backend 10/10 pytest cases pass: public /api/app-mgmt/config/{customer,partner} shape (platform, version_code, latest_version, apk_url absolute, apk_size, update_enabled, force_update) with seeded partner (vcode=5, v1.0.5, 300KB); invalid platform → 400. NEW /api/app-mgmt/download/{platform}: partner → 302 to absolute apk_url; customer (no apk) → 404; invalid → 400. /api/media/file/app-mgmt/partner/test.apk: full → 200 with exact byte length; Range 'bytes=100-199' → 206 + Content-Range 'bytes 100-199/307200' + Accept-Ranges + correct deterministic payload; open-ended 'bytes=start-' → 206 streams to EOF (resume works). Admin web /admin?tab=app_mgmt → Partner App tab shows apk-current-partner (Uploaded · app.azoapp.partner · v1.0.5 · 300 KB), apk-direct-link-partner with code value https://.../api/app-mgmt/download/partner, apk-copy-link-partner click copies that exact URL to clipboard (verified). Expo code review: Partner & Customer AppUpdateGate.tsx use expo-file-system/legacy createDownloadResumable with 5-attempt retry+resume, size verification against apk_size, getContentUriAsync + IntentLauncher ACTION_VIEW (fallback INSTALL_PACKAGE) — never Play Store. withAutoVersionName.js plugins registered in both app.json; eas.json has appVersionSource remote + autoIncrement; gradle line appended correctly derives versionName from versionCode. presign_s3 now uses regional endpoint + SigV4 (code-reviewed; S3 not configured in preview so no live test). Fake partner app_config record and dummy /app/backend/uploads/app-mgmt/partner/test.apk cleaned up after testing (apk fields reset, update_enabled false).
critical_code_review_comments: AppUpdateGate (both apps): resumable.resumeAsync() is called after a transient throw even though the previous createDownloadResumable may have already failed partway without .savable() yielding resumeData — the code guards for !saved?.resumeData by starting fresh, which is correct, but the retry loop treats non-2xx HTTP responses (e.g. 404/5xx) as success-then-reject only after full write; consider validating result.status immediately per attempt (currently only after loop exits).

download_latest returns 302 with Cache-Control: no-store but the redirected media/file response for .apk is served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=2592000, immutable from serve_file — a replaced APK keeping the same storage name (very unlikely with the uuid suffix in apk_name, so fine in practice) could be stale. Current apk_name uses the upload_id suffix so this is safe; just noting.

withAutoVersionName appends a line to app/build.gradle on every prebuild; running `npx expo prebuild` without cleanup can shadow a managed project. The TAG-based de-dup makes it idempotent, but the generated versionName uses String concat with an Integer in Gradle — works because Groovy coerces, but a leading comment/space before the TAG on subsequent runs will stop the filter from removing the prior line. Low risk; keeps the TAG literal.

No gating on apk_size==0 before enabling 'Update Enabled' in the admin UI/backend — admin could enable update with no APK uploaded (apk_url blank). The mobile gate falls open (requires apk_url), so this does not cause the reported bug, but a server-side guard would prevent a misconfig.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded db.app_config partner doc {apk_url:/api/media/file/app-mgmt/partner/test.apk, apk_size:307200, apk_version_code:5, apk_version_name:'1.0.5', apk_package:'app.azoapp.partner', update_enabled:true} and dummy 300KB deterministic file at /app/backend/uploads/app-mgmt/partner/test.apk. Both reset after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run, reseed via: db.app_config.update_one({'platform':'partner'}, {'$set':{...apk fields..., 'update_enabled':True}}, upsert=True) and write 300KB bytes([i%256 for i in range(307200)]) to /app/backend/uploads/app-mgmt/partner/test.apk. Then pytest tests/test_app_mgmt_download_iter242.py -o addopts= (xdist parallel caused a false ReadTimeout on first config call; -o addopts= disables parallel). Native Android install can't be executed here — AppUpdateGate.tsx validated by code review only.
rca of the issue: Reported 'Unable to download the update' was fixed by: (1) new GET /api/app-mgmt/download/{platform} that 302-redirects to the absolute apk_url (so partner devices can always reach the APK via a stable link), (2) /api/media/file/*.apk honoring Range → 206 so interrupted downloads resume instead of restart, and (3) Expo gate using createDownloadResumable with 5-attempt retry + size verification + getContentUriAsync + IntentLauncher ACTION_VIEW. The retry preserves resumeData across attempts, so flaky connections no longer surface the generic 'check your connection' message immediately; and surface-level errors now carry the real reason (server status or incomplete file). versionName auto-bumps via withAutoVersionName.js plugin reading EAS-written versionCode.
